tasks.title: Reconcile main and record the real baseline
tasks.deliverable: Inspect existing data, guards, regression tests and current UI; record measured baseline and reuse/repair decisions. No production mutation.

tasks.title: Additive collaboration data and permission foundation
tasks.deliverable: Map/reuse existing provider and partner-contract records; add only necessary opt-in preferences, private roster and inquiry structures with authorized projections and safe migration tests.

tasks.title: Two-sided need discovery and evidence-led matching
tasks.deliverable: Explicitly published needs for freelancers, complementary provider search for agencies, hard filters, stable pagination and explainable portfolio-based ranking; leave client matching untouched.

tasks.title: Fresh manual availability and declared capacity
tasks.deliverable: Implement private/opt-in availability intervals, timezone handling, freshness/expiry and explicit unknown states without implying external-calendar synchronization.

tasks.title: Private roster, consented invites and rehire entry
tasks.deliverable: Save providers into tenant-private groups with restricted notes; consented expiring invitations, deduplication, blocking/cooldowns and existing-account linking.

tasks.title: Structured work inquiries and private quote comparison
tasks.deliverable: Project-linked or standalone scope/date/currency/mode inquiry with recipient preview, replies/counteroffers and clear handoff into the existing supplier-authored partner contract.

tasks.title: Complete R1 UX, regression checks and verified release
tasks.deliverable: Deliver a complete mobile/desktop discover-to-contract handoff and rehire path. No unfinished R2/R3 UI. Record source, checks, migrations, screenshots, rollback and production evidence separately.

tasks.title: Versioned work orders linked to authoritative contracts
tasks.deliverable: Add buyer/supplier work-order projection and accepted-scope versioning; preserve supplier agency_id ownership, signed contract hashes and private optional parent-project association.

tasks.title: Audience-scoped threads, sharing and recipient preview
tasks.deliverable: Separate agency-private, work-order and client channels with shared server-side policies and matching preview projections; cover caches, SSR/RSC, exports, jobs and file signing.

tasks.title: Versioned assets and contextual creative review
tasks.deliverable: Integrate private asset versions and review comments using the existing media stack; test file restrictions, scoped access and preserved feedback history.

tasks.title: Reviewer workflow and truthful payment projections
tasks.deliverable: Private supplier work goes to its buying agency, disclosed shares retain client review. Reuse guarded authoritative transitions; no new rails, rates, waived-project rules or real-money activation.

tasks.title: Atomic capacity confirmation and expiry
tasks.deliverable: Prevent over-allocation of capacity declared in Sawwiq using transaction-safe acceptance, idempotency, expiry and release. Test concurrency on PGlite and Postgres.

tasks.title: Complete R2 multi-party delivery and verified release
tasks.deliverable: Run private and disclosed delivery/revision/cancellation/dispute flows with distinct sessions; review permissions and actual media before publishing only the complete slice.

tasks.title: Human-controlled scope-to-team planner
tasks.deliverable: Deterministic taxonomy-first work-package drafts and authorized candidate explanations; optional budgeted AI, prompt-injection tests, minimal model context and safe no-key fallback.

tasks.title: Private cost worksheet and recurring work drafts
tasks.deliverable: Finance-scoped quote/margin planning, explicit unknown/currency handling and reusable production/rehire templates; every cycle requires new confirmation, with no auto-charge or renewal.

tasks.title: Permissioned collaborator evidence and moderation
tasks.deliverable: Create a separate transaction-linked collaborator-feedback class with consent, confidentiality, moderation and dispute paths; preserve all existing client/Google/payment provenance.

tasks.title: Next-action dashboard, preferences and trustworthy metrics
tasks.deliverable: Reuse notification adapters/jobs for deduplicated privacy-safe next actions; add opt-outs and instrument pseudonymous funnel and cohort metrics without fabricating demand.

tasks.title: Integrated V2 quality, deployment and evaluation handoff
tasks.deliverable: Validate all delivered software and production evidence, prepare the consent-based pilot, and report real measured outcomes only. Longitudinal business results may remain pending after software release.
